title: Prime-boundary lifting for square-free cyclic groups

hypotheses.base_case: every spectral subset of Z/nZ tiles

conclusion.structure: A and Lambda have one point on every p-level

imported_results: prime cyclotomic zero is equivalent to equal p-level cardinalities

proof_steps.name: equality-case descent
proof_steps.claim: If |E|=p and Phi_p does not divide m_E, then Phi_(dp)|m_E implies Phi_d|m_E
proof_steps.mechanism: A nonzero cuboid evaluation is a multiple of p and bounded by p; equality forces every p-level to be nonempty, hence singleton, contradicting the missing Phi_p zero

proof_steps.name: both-absent exclusion
proof_steps.claim: Phi_p cannot be absent from both masks
proof_steps.mechanism: Both projections are injective; equality-case descent makes the p-image spectral in Z/nZ with forbidden cardinality p

proof_steps.name: one-sided exclusion
proof_steps.claim: Phi_p absent from m_A and present in m_Lambda is impossible
proof_steps.mechanism: Lambda is injective over Z/nZ and has one point per p-level; levelwise descent makes its projection p pairwise orthogonal characters on every nonempty A-level, forcing a size-p spectral set in Z/nZ

proof_steps.name: conclusion
proof_steps.mechanism: The preceding alternatives exhaust the spectral-pair cases; apply symmetry

specialization.base_theorem: Fuglede holds for cyclic groups of order pqrs
specialization.result: every 11-point spectral subset of Z/2310Z tiles

trust_boundary.role: machine-readable audit map of the human-checkable proof
